title: Greek Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew with eggplant, perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.notes: to add depth to the stew

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the eggplant cubes and sauté until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, stew, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
